raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Recent per-tensor FP8 sink/split support left two eligibility tests asserting the old contract. This produces four failures in the SM100/SM103 FROST suite even on the parent of #1936.

Update the SM100 paged FP8 sink/split assertion to expect admission. Keep SM120 FP8 sink/split rejection covered without matching a diagnostic sentence that enumerates unrelated architectures. Production code and selection policy are unchanged.

Validation: the same four failures reproduce on #1936's parent and head with CuTeDSL 4.8.0; these five focused cases pass after the change, including the existing SM120 half-precision positive and FP8 negative controls. Verified the exact Python/native imports and that CUDA remained uninitialized. Scoped pre-commit hooks pass.

detail.title: test: refresh sink split eligibility assertions

files.patch:
@@ -331,7 +331,7 @@ def test_sm120_split_sink_is_eligible_on_the_half_row_only(d):
     if d <= 256:
         fp8 = _sink_decode_facts(d_qk=d, d_v=d, dtype=cudnn.data_type.FP8_E4M3, dtype_o=cudnn.data_type.HALF, is_fp8=True)
         reason = mismatch(rows["sdpa_fwd_prefill_sm120_fp8"], fp8, knobs)
-        assert reason is not None and "a sink splits on the SM100, SM107 and SM120 half flavors only" in reason, reason
+        assert reason is not None, "SM120 FP8 sink/split is still unsupported"
     validate_params(TemplateParams(has_sink=True, split_kv=4))
     with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="served by the FP16/BF16 templates only"):
         validate_params(TemplateParams(dtype_qkv=DTYPE_E4M3, has_sink=True, split_kv=4), allowed_dtypes=(DTYPE_E4M3,))

@@ -2561,7 +2561,7 @@ def paged_facts(**kw):
         assert engines.mismatch(fp8, sink_facts) is None
         split_knobs = engines.SdpaFwdKnobs(sched_policy=0, tile_m=128, tile_n=128, cga=1, pack_gqa=False, split_kv=2)
         assert engines.mismatch(fp8, paged_facts(is_fp8=True, d_qk=d, d_v=d), split_knobs) is None
-        assert "sink-free dense" in engines.mismatch(fp8, sink_facts, split_knobs)
+        assert engines.mismatch(fp8, sink_facts, split_knobs) is None
     # Block-scaled O (#1088) over pools: epilogue and loader are independent, but the pair is not validated.
     assert "block-scaled O" in engines.mismatch(fp8, paged_facts(is_fp8=True, dtype_o=cudnn.data_type.FP8_E4M3, o_block_scale=32))
     assert "block-scaled O" in engines.mismatch(mxfp8, paged_facts(is_mxfp8=True, page_size=128, dtype_o=cudnn.data_type.FP8_E4M3, o_block_scale=32))
